Editor, Catholic News: Page 5
1922, September 27.
May the Good God deliver us from scandals! But I would ask his Lord- ship from Buffalo and his Grace from Baltimore if "Eamon DeValera seems to have completely lost his reason", who is to blame, if not the despicable power his own Grace and his lordship seem to be now espousing and that DeValera has frustrated, escaped and withstood these four years -- so long and so bitter for poor Ireland, and for DeValera? What is to blame after British hypocrisy more than the above mentioned international silence? More than the already referred to leaders and guides? May God in his mercy overlook the crime of it all and pity such leaders and their respon- sibility. Your correspondent prays for them without exception.
But if Eamon DeValera, as it is honestly believed, has still his wits about him, is it not really next to a miracle of God's Providence? If he still has 30,000 patriot soldiers behind him, though practically without arms, is there not still hope for "Self Determination", and hope for Democracy?
At all events, if Almighty God is in favor of the principle of "self- determination" for men of free-will, then the majority in Ireland is behind the soul of the Republic still: and notwithstanding all reports to the con- trary, and all criticisms to the contrary, and all powers to the contrary, if God is still for Principle and for the Republic of Ireland, the majority in Ireland are behind DeValera; and DeValera, appealing to the Sacred Heart, as when sentenced to be shot in 1916, will triumph in the end over every enemy, if need be even as the Maiden-Soldier Saint triumped in the crown of a glorious Martyrdom!
Very sincerely yours, for an ideal Catholic Press-independent of atheistic, blasphemous wires, and for decently truthful reports or nothing, about the Irish Republican Army, so heroically struggling just now, against masked British Invasion of their country and against the referred to inter- national outrage on human liberty, and on God of that liberty-the Divine Source and foundation of individual hope and of international confidence!
I remain Homo Simplex, A. A. R.I. R.
/s/ (Fr. Solanus O.F.M. Cap.)
